name: Support Brennan/Lysa A
_source: speak;Lysa;What do you do with the people you've lost?
speak;Brennan;I remember their names. Every one. Every campaign.
speak;Brennan;No. But you get better at carrying it.
speak;Lysa;I want to get better at the carrying part.
speak;Brennan;You already are. Stronger than you think, Sister Lysa.
